script.description: Non-interactive script displayed exactly in local approval UI.
script.title: Script

shell.description: Exact shell grammar for the script.
shell.title: Shell

reason.description: Safe concise reason recorded with the cancellation event.
reason.title: Reason

action.description: Read job state/output after a cursor.
action.title: Action

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 output bytes returned by one poll page. Continue from next_sequence_cursor while has_more_output is true.
max_output_bytes.title: Max Output Bytes

sequence_cursor.description: Return chunks with sequence strictly greater than this value.
sequence_cursor.title: Sequence Cursor

wait_milliseconds.description: Maximum bounded long-poll wait; zero returns immediately.
wait_milliseconds.title: Wait Milliseconds

action.description: Start a new bounded shell job.
action.title: Action

approval_timeout_seconds.description: Time allowed for Windows consent, separate from process timeout.
approval_timeout_seconds.title: Approval Timeout Seconds

command.description: Structured argv or an explicit PowerShell/cmd script.

execution.description: Use native_approval to request one-shot Windows approval for installed host tools and full logged-in-user filesystem/network access. It is a request, never proof of approval. project_policy keeps the local mode.
execution.title: Execution

external_working_directory.description: Absolute local Windows cwd outside the project, e.g. C:/. Requires local consent; never marks a request approved.
external_working_directory.title: External Working Directory

idempotency_key.description: Detect duplicate submission; never authorizes automatic uncertain replay.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

output_limit_bytes.description: Combined stdout/stderr cap before truncation/termination policy.
output_limit_bytes.title: Output Limit Bytes

project_id.description: Opaque ID from list_projects; never a local path.
project_id.title: Project Id

purpose.description: Short human-readable reason shown in history/UI.
purpose.title: Purpose

requested_external_paths.description: Declare every intended outside-project file/directory access. Native project policy checks declared and literal paths, not arbitrary program behavior. Requires Windows consent.
requested_external_paths.title: Requested External Paths

start_wait_milliseconds.description: Bounded event-driven wait for the first start-state transition. This keeps the initial tool call open briefly while the user answers Windows approval without turning approval into a blocking process execution. Zero returns immediately.
start_wait_milliseconds.title: Start Wait Milliseconds

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock deadline enforced on the process tree.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

working_directory.description: Project-relative working directory; empty means root.
working_directory.title: Working Directory

arguments.description: Ordered argv values passed without joining.
arguments.title: Arguments

environment.description: Bounded requested overrides; local policy sanitizes and may reject them.
environment.title: Environment

executable.description: Command name or project-relative executable path; never an absolute local path.
executable.title: Executable
